audience: product and marketing teams that check and correct event data in Usermaven

useCases.title: Find the events of one order
useCases.text: Look up events by type, time range and an attribute, such as an order id. The lookup returns at most 10 events, newest first. It needs the Server Token.

useCases.title: Check which workspaces the API key reaches
useCases.text: List the Usermaven workspaces that the API key can access. Use it first to confirm that the connection works.

useCases.title: Correct a wrong value on an ingested event
useCases.text: Find the event, then merge the corrected attribute into it, such as a final order price. Reuse the same idempotency key to retry safely.
